get.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Audit_log Collection records. Supports filtering, sorting, and expanding relations.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filtering expression (e.g., 'created > "2022-01-01"')

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of fields to sort by. Prefix with '-' for descending order.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number (starting from 1)

parameters.name: perPage
parameters.description: Number of records per page (max 500)

parameters.name: skipTotal
parameters.description: Set to true to skip the total count (improves performance for large collections)

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of relations to expand. Use dot notation for nested relations.

x-notes.description:
### Expansion Options

This endpoint supports expanding relations. Use the `expand` parameter with any of the following paths:

- `created_by`
- `updated_by`

You can also combine multiple expansions with commas (e.g., `expand=field1,field2.nested`).

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of relations to expand. Use dot notation for nested relations.
